feature: P4.4 HWPX polygon vertex insertion and deletion
previousLimitation: Point edits could change coordinates of existing vertices only.
supported: An owned, unlocked, size-unprotected, top-level HWPX simple closed polygon with the P4 transform proof. Insertion chooses an exact interior integer point on the selected outgoing edge. Deletion re-closes the ordered list using the new first point. Each edit is reversible independently.
refused: Open, self-intersecting, degenerate, ambiguous, transformed and grouped paths. Fewer than three or more than 256 distinct vertices, off-edge points, repeated closure index and winding reversal, HWP5 and DOCX structural edits.
